prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A vibrant, whimsical scene set in a sunlit city square, featuring a group of LEGO-style astronaut minifigures collaboratively constructing a massive red heart out of oversized LEGO bricks. The heart, partially completed, dominates the center of the composition, its bold red color contrasting against the soft blue sky filled with fluffy, painterly clouds. Several astronauts, dressed in white and red space suits with reflective visors, are actively engaged in the building process—some stand atop ladders, others hand bricks to each other, while a few pose proudly in front of their creation. The background reveals ornate, European-style buildings with spires and intricate facades, adding a sense of grandeur and depth. The ground is scattered with loose red bricks, suggesting ongoing work. The lighting is bright and natural, casting crisp shadows and enhancing the playful, optimistic mood. The overall style is highly detailed and cinematic, with a slight tilt-up camera angle and a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the heart and the astronauts, while the cityscape softly recedes into the background. The color palette is dominated by primary reds, blues, and yellows, evoking a sense of joy and creativity, reminiscent of a high-quality animated film or a dynamic storybook illustration.
